errors.text_span: тъмносинята линия („Чехия“) започва около X≈70–71, Y≈45–46
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the dark blue line for Czechia starts at coordinates (X≈70–71, Y≈45–46). The actual starting point of this line is at approximately X≈50, Y≈39. The coordinates mentioned in the description correspond to a point in the middle of the line's trajectory, not its beginning.
